post.originalText:
Okay, motion designers are 100% cooked.

Saw on x that Opus 5.5 could do advanced animations and I was skeptical at first. 

So I gave it a one sentence prompt, and it one shot this in 15 minutes.

Will add the prompt below, but this is genuinely mind blowing.

This level of work would have costed $8,000 - $10,000  with a motion design team and 3-4 week turnaround with multiple revisions.

Claude did it in one go with this prompt:

"make a dynamic 15-second motion graphics video that shows what an incredible motion designer you are, like it's your showreel for a résumé. go all out."

The only thing remaining for humans is creativity and critical thinking.
